finalists.label: Infectious Mononucleosis
finalists.why: The presence of bilateral parotitis, an itchy maculopapular morbilliform rash, and a positive EBV viral capsid IgM antibody strongly support this diagnosis.

finalists.label: Drug-induced Liver Injury
finalists.why: The significant elevation in ALT and ALP following clarithromycin intake suggests a possible drug-induced liver injury.

frontier_selector.why: The decisive evidence of a positive EBV viral capsid IgM antibody and the clinical presentation of bilateral parotitis and a morbilliform rash specifically support Infectious Mononucleosis over Drug-induced Liver Injury.

support_spans: bilateral parotitis and an itchy maculopapular morbilliform rash
Positive EBV viral capsid IgM antibody

contradict_spans: No signs of chronic liver disease

support_spans: 10-day history of vomiting, myalgia, and upper abdominal pain
